params.prompt:
Create a standalone illustration.
Subject: Two fictional adults separated by an impossibly tangled velvet rope
Visible action: Each holding a different end of the same rope, trying to work out whether to enter or leave
Setting: A lavish rooftop entrance with doors opening onto more velvet ropes
Visual joke: A casual arrangement requires the navigation skills of a labyrinth
Motifs: velvet rope maze, unlatched clasp, two abandoned drinks
Composition: Rope knots dominate the foreground; both adults readable behind them, neither cast as the villain

Rich fantasy trading-card detail, dramatic yet readable light, expressive body language, and clear foreground/background separation. Colorful Web 2.0 pastel palette: mint, lavender, peach, cyan, cream. Keep the main silhouette readable at phone size and leave quiet breathing room around the edges. Original composition; any people are fictional adults. Landscape 4:3 illustration only. No text, lettering, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, card frame, rules box, or user interface.

Rendering direction for this study:
Paint an original satirical fantasy trading-card illustration in opaque gouache and fine digital brushwork. Give an ordinary adult social mishap the staging and light of an epic confrontation. Keep contemporary clothing and everyday objects recognizable. Faces and hands are expressive, with believable anatomy and slightly exaggerated acting. The embarrassment should feel familiar, never cruel.

Use mint #BCEAD5, lavender #CDBCF6, peach #FFC4AC, cyan #A9E5F2, and warm cream #FFF5DC. Deep plum #34263F supplies shadow and silhouette contrast. These colors guide the painting; do not draw palette swatches. Build the scene from broad readable shapes, then add material detail around the focal gesture. Avoid a uniform pastel haze, glossy plastic skin, flat icon art, and generic fantasy armor.

Keep the essential faces, hands, and joke-bearing objects inside the central 80 percent of the canvas. Background detail stays quiet. The joke must remain visible in a 200-pixel-wide preview. Finish as one opaque landscape illustration, with no surrounding card, collage, lettering, captions, logos, or UI.
